Curfew's almost here, so I'm heading back!
If you've got time for this, you'd be way better off training!
And keeping public morals in check is my duty!

Ugh, well... I did enforce discipline properly, but
I still feel kinda uneasy about it, y'know...

Come on, back to the dorms! As disciplinary committee head,
I can't just overlook what you two are doing!

No! What you're trying to do right now is a violation!
No matter the reason, rules must be obeyed!

We run from morning till night, and even on days off we're told to do solo training!
Is it wrong to want a breather once in a while?!

"Scandal at the Prestigious Tracen Academy?!
Has Slackness Infected the Elite School? Public Morals in Total Disarray..."

As disciplinary committee head, I will protect everyone
from these nasty gossips...! Without fail!

We're always training hard anyway!
Saying stuff like that... you sound just like my trainer...!
Wh-Wh-What on earth is thiiiis?!

Tracen Academy has tightened security and issued warnings to students,
and no issues like the ones described in the article have occurred thus far—

Lately, the discipline rules suddenly got way stricter too...
I'm so sick of feeling suffocated like this!!

This is already the third time this month!
And this time, of all things, it's "Public Morals in Disarray"!!

...slackness like that will only lead to bigger problems!
Tomorrow, I'm cracking down even harder!!
Th-That's...!

While she believed she hadn't done anything wrong, she also seemed bothered
by the fact that the other students had a point of their own.

Wait, those two leaving the dorms at this hour... It's dangerous,
and it could lead to another scandal! I'm going after them!
Ack! The disciplinary committee head?!

Heheh, that's my Trainer for ya!
Compared to you, I've still got a long way to go.

That settles it!
Until peace returns to our academy, I'll step up the disciplinary patrols!

Talk it out... Understood!
As disciplinary head, I'll reach out to them with absolute sincerity!!

I can't get what they said out of my head.
What those two were trying to do was wrong, but—
Reaching out...

Trainer, thank you so much
for keeping me company until this late hour...

You there!
Your skirt hem is one millimeter shorter than regulations allow!!

You there! The court was reserved to be split in half!
Crossing over the line is strictly forbidden, even on break!

You there! You're two seconds late!
Being late to school leads to being late out of the gate in races!!

Oooohhhhhh!!!!!
From now on, I'll train and discipline myself even moreeee!!

It's true, all I was thinking about was cracking down on people.
Just now, and before that too.

With attention on the racing world reaching new heights lately,
it seemed gossip rags had turned to covering the athletes as well.

We run from morning till night, and even on days off we're told to do solo training!
Is it wrong to want a breather once in a while?!

"Endless Appetite Leaves Local Diners Crying for Mercy,"
"Public Nuisance! Is the Ghost Actually a Super-Speed Umamusume?!"—

The article's a misunderstanding, but having that written might mean
there really was "slackness" in the committee... or rather, in me as head.

You there! Even high school division students
aren't allowed in arcades at this hour! That's a moral code violation!

Guh, curfew's coming right up!
And there are still so many violations I haven't addressed...!
